text: Current incoming/outgoing OAuth visibility code sanitizes the current hostname input. Incoming Exchange configuration derives it from the typed URL. Preserve this direct input boundary when refactoring validation; checking only the cached config can show an option for the previous server. This is source and test inspection only.
